result.instructions: Tools for Plivo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Send an SMS to +14155550123 saying our delivery arrives tomorrow between 9 and 12."; "Which of our outbound messages failed in the last batch, and why?"; "Show the calls that are live right now and where they are calling from.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Plivo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run plivo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run plivo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run plivo_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. plivo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: plivo_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Get the Plivo account for the configured Auth ID: name, account type (standard or developer trial), billing mode and remaining cash credits in USD. Good first call to check the connection. Plivo API: GET /v1/Account/{auth_id}/.

tools.name: plivo_list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: List SMS and MMS message detail records on the account, newest first, with direction, state, from/to numbers, and charges. Plivo API: GET /v1/Account/{auth_id}/Message/.

limit.description: Results per page (1-20, Plivo maximum). Default: 20.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging.

message_direction.description: Only inbound or only outbound messages.

tools.name: plivo_get_message
tools.title: Get a message
tools.description: Get one message detail record by message_uuid: state (queued, sent, delivered, failed, ...), error_code, from and to numbers, and total_amount. Plivo API: GET /v1/Account/{auth_id}/Message/{message_uuid}/.

tools.name: plivo_send_sms
tools.title: Send an SMS
tools.description: Send one SMS to one recipient from a sender number. This sends a real text message that costs money and cannot be recalled. Plain SMS only (no MMS, no WhatsApp). Plivo API: POST /v1/Account/{auth_id}/Message/ with type=sms.

src.description: Sender: a Plivo number in E.164 format, or an alphanumeric Sender ID where Plivo allows it.

dst.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format. One recipient per call.

text.description: Message text: up to 1,600 characters (plain ASCII), or 737 characters if it has non-ASCII characters.

tools.name: plivo_list_calls
tools.title: List calls
tools.description: List voice calls on the account. Use status=live for calls in progress or status=queued for calls waiting to start. Plivo API: GET /v1/Account/{auth_id}/Call/.

limit.description: Results per page (1-20, Plivo maximum). Default: 20.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging.

status.description: Only calls in progress (live) or waiting (queued).

from_number.description: Only calls made from this caller number.

tools.name: plivo_get_call
tools.title: Get a call
tools.description: Get one call by call_uuid: status, direction, from and to numbers, duration, and billing. Plivo API: GET /v1/Account/{auth_id}/Call/{call_uuid}/.

tools.name: plivo_make_call
tools.title: Make an outbound call
tools.description: Start one outbound voice call. Plivo rings the 'to' number and, when answered, requests answer_url, which must return Plivo XML. This places a real call that costs money and cannot be recalled. Plivo API: POST /v1/Account/{auth_id}/Call/.

from.description: Caller ID: a Plivo number in E.164 format that the account owns.

to.description: Destination number in E.164 format. One destination per call.

answer_url.description: Public https URL that Plivo requests when the call is answered. It must return Plivo XML.

answer_method.description: HTTP method for answer_url (Plivo default: POST).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Plivo
prompts.description: What you can do with Plivo here, with example requests to try.
